title: Arabic — Audio-First MSA to C2
source_policy: Active foundation/intermediate curriculum uses free/open sources: ANU Marhaba, Wisconsin, MSU OER, LQToronto/Madina and DLI GLOSS. Gateway and Al Jazeera are deferred outside the active path.

course_sequence.title: Free Intensive MSA Foundation to Independent Bridge
course_sequence.target: strong A2 / early B1 bridge if checkpoints are passed

reality_rule: Do not promise C2 in a few months. The 20-week program is an intensive complete foundation/independent bridge; continue toward B2/C1/C2 based on demonstrated proficiency.

stages.goal: Greetings, identity, family, gender/agreement, questions, pronouns, possession, prepositions, numbers, core present tense, nominal/verbal sentences and high-frequency vocabulary.
stages.exit: Produce and understand basic exchanges and short connected MSA without relying on memorized scripts.

active_sources: MSU Elementary Arabic II Standard-Arabic sections
stages.goal: Connected descriptions, routine exchanges, present/past/future basics, idafa, plurals, time, routine, hobbies, weather, city descriptions and short narratives.
stages.exit: Understand clear familiar MSA, write connected short paragraphs and sustain 2–5 minute prepared-to-semi-spontaneous speech.

stages.goal: Independent comprehension of clear standard speech, narratives, explanations and reasons/opinions.
stages.exit: Follow main points of standard media on familiar topics and produce connected summaries/opinions.

stages.goal: Extended discourse, abstract topics, natural speed, flexible grammar and broad productive vocabulary.
Implicit meaning, academic/professional register, dense native media, stylistic control and sustained spontaneous expression.
Near-complete comprehension across registers; precise nuance; multi-source synthesis; specialized vocabulary and effortless reformulation.
stages.exit: Meet C2 descriptors across listening, reading, speaking, writing, interaction and mediation; playlist completion alone is insufficient.

parallel_branches.quranic_classical: Use Madina/LQ as an early grammar bridge; deepen systematically after the MSA foundation.
parallel_branches.dialect: Keep MSU Egyptian conversation modules optional and explicitly tagged; add a chosen dialect intentionally after stable MSA foundations.
parallel_branches.pronunciation: Continuous audio shadowing and targeted Wisconsin/MSU sound review.
